auth_type.title: Authentication Method
auth_type.description: How to authenticate to GitHub: a Personal Access Token you supply, or OAuth (authorize via the authorization button above).

options.tooltip: Create a classic (`ghp_…`) or fine-grained (`github_pat_…`) PAT in **GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens**. Required scopes: `read:org`, `repo`. If your organization enforces SAML SSO you must also SSO-authorize the token before use.

api_base_url.title: GitHub API Base URL (Enterprise only)
api_base_url.description: Leave empty for github.com. Set it only if you use GitHub Enterprise.

options.tooltip:
The REST API root of your GitHub Enterprise host.

- **Enterprise Cloud with data residency** (`SUBDOMAIN.ghe.com`): use `https://api.SUBDOMAIN.ghe.com`.
- **Enterprise Server** (self-hosted): use `https://HOSTNAME/api/v3`.

Enterprise hosts require a Personal Access Token created on that host — OAuth works on github.com only. If your Enterprise tenant restricts access by IP, allow your Keboola stack's outbound IP addresses.
